title: Q1 Results This Week: BEL, HUL, L&T, Dixon among nearly 200 stocks report numbers - CNBC TV18
summary: Nearly 200 companies will report June quarter results this week on Dalal Street, including major Nifty 50 names such as Bharat Electronics (BEL), Hindustan Unilever, Larsen & Toubro, Dixon and Persistent Systems. The schedule spans Monday through the following Sunday, with a wide mix of corporates from banks and FMCG to tech and industrials announcing results each day.
content:
It promises to be yet another result-heavy week on Dalal Street as plenty of Nifty 50 and broader market companies will be reporting their June quarter results all through the week, including on Sunday, when Persistent Systems reports its numbers. Bharat Electronics (BEL), Coal India, Hindustan Unilever, Larsen & Toubro are some of the other major Nifty 50 names announcing their numbers this week. Here's a complete list of the important results for the upcoming week:

Monday, July 27 |Aeroflex Industries, Aurionpro Solutions, Balaji Amines, Bharat Electronics (BEL), Canara Bank, CCL Products, Coal India, Coforge, Emkay, Epigral, Gallant Ispat, Godfrey Phillips, Gravita India, Happiest Minds, Home First Finance, HUDCO, IFB Agro, Indus Towers, JK Paper, Mold-Tek Packaging, NESCO, Northern Arc, PN Gadgil Jewellers, RR Kabel, Sagar Cement, Senores Pharma, Sumitomo Chemicals, Tata Chemicals, Tata Power, Tejas Network, Tilaknagar Industries, and Tamilnad Mercantile Bank

Tuesday, July 28 |Ambuja Cements, Birlasoft, Century Enka, Cholamandalam Finance, City Union Bank, DCM Shriram, Dwarikesh Suga, Equitas Small Finance Bank, Hindustan Unilever, Indoco Remedies, L&T, Netweb Technologies, Paradeep Phosphates, Pfizer, Phoenix Mills, Pine Labs, Radico Khaitan, Sanofi Consumer, Supreme Industries, Suzlon, Tata Capital, TruAlt Biosciences, TTK Prestige, Varun Beverages, VST Industries

Wednesday, July 29 |ACME Solar, Adani Enterprises, Adani Ports, ADF Foods, Aequs, Asian Paints, Bajaj Housing Finance, Blackbuck, CarTrade Tech, Chalet Hotels, Chemfab Alkalis, Colgate-Palmolive, Craftsman Automation, Dabur, Devyani International, Dhanlaxmi Bank, Eicher Motors, E-Mudhra, Eris Lifesciences, Force Motors, Garden Reach Shipbuilders, Hawkins Cookers, Heidelberg Cement, Honeywell Automation, Hexaware Technologies, J&K Bank, JK Lakshmi Cement, Kissht, KPIT Tech, Karnataka Bank, Laxmi Organic, Maharashtra Scooter, MAS Financial, MOIL, Meghmani Organics, MTAR Tech, PCBL, Procter & Gamble Hygiene & Healthcare, Piramal Pharma, Prestige Estates, Quess Corp, Redington, Refex Industries, Sharda Cropchem, Star Health Insurance, Syngene, Syrma SGS, TBO Tech, Teamlease, Thangamayil, Triveni Engineering, V-Guard, Vinati Organics, Vintage Coffee, Waaree Energies, and Zensar Tech

Thursday, July 30 |Aarti Industries, Ajanta Pharma, Archean Chemicals, Apollo Pipes, AWL Agri, Bajaj Finance, Chambal Fertilisers, Data Patterns, Deepak Fertilisers, Exide Industries, Filatex India, Gillette India, Go Colours, Hester Biosciences, Hyundai Motor India, ICRA, IRFC, JBM Auto, LIC Housing Finance, LT Foods, M&M, Mankind Pharma, Mazagon Dock, Global Health, Mahanagar Gas, Niva Bupa, NSDL, Nucleus Software, Nuvama Wealth, Pricol, PSP Projects, Quick Heal, RailTel, Rainbow Children Healthcare, Swiggy, Tata Steel, Transport Corporation of India, Thermax, Torrent Pharma, Vedanta Aluminium, Vedanta, Westlife Foodworld

Friday, July 31 |Aadhaar Housing Finance, Aarti Drugs, ABB India, Aditya Birla Capital, Aether Industries, Aptus Value Housing, Astec Life, Bajaj Finserv, Bajaj Holdings, Bluedart, Century Plyboard, Corona Remedies, Dhampur Sugar, Dixon Technologies, ESAF Small Finance Bank, GAIL, Glenmark, GMDC, Intellect Design Arena, Indian Oil, ITC, Jagran Prakashan, Kajaria Ceramics, Kesoram Industries, Kirloskar Brothers, Maruti, LG Balakrishnan & Brothers, NALCO, Shree Cement, SJVN, Star Cement, Sun Pharma, Taj GVK, and Voltamp Transformers

Saturday, August 1 |APL Apollo Tubes, Balmer Lawrie, Clean Sciences, Divi's Laboratories, GHCL, Latent View Analytics, Muthoot Finance, Nilkamal, Persistent Systems (Sunday, August 2)

The weekly earnings calendar covers a broad cross-section of sectors including public sector units, private banks, financial services, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals, industrials, technology firms and renewable energy companies. Investors, analysts and market participants will be watching these results closely for earnings beats or misses, margin trends, guidance and commentary on demand conditions across segments. The heavy flow of corporate results is likely to influence intraday market volatility and sectoral performance throughout the week.
